answers.goal: I would love to be an independent video creator who makes content on YouTube. I’ve always found storytelling to be a compelling and amazing art, and I hope to do that in the future as well.
answers.drew: Ever since I was younger it was the only thing that ever consistently kept my attention. Sports, movies, the internet, it was all I ever wanted to be a part of. I’m pursuing a degree in marketing due to these interests, and I couldn’t be happier.
answers.seeking: I want to meet people who are proud and passionate about what they do.
answers.inspiration: Casey Neistat. All the vlogs I’ve ever created in my spare time all go back to him.
